items.title: Writes in your voice
items.body: Trained on posts you've already written — paste them, upload a file, or import your LinkedIn export. Linka learns your hooks, rhythm and sign-offs.

items.title: Rewrites, never cross-posts
items.body: The same idea becomes a LinkedIn story, an X one-liner and a Reddit post with no marketing voice. Length, tone and format follow each platform.

items.title: Designs the visuals
items.body: Images built from the post's own world, in your brand colours, with your logo placed where you want it. Landscape, square or portrait.

items.title: Puts you on camera
items.body: Turns a post into a talking-head video with your avatar and voice — vertical or landscape, in the language you wrote it in. No filming, no editing.

items.title: Writes in your language
items.body: Set your language once and the post, the title, the hashtags and the replies all come out native — not English run through a translator.

items.title: Hashtags and titles that behave
items.body: Three tags on LinkedIn, five on Instagram, none on Reddit — enforced, not requested. Tags are picked after reading the finished post, never invented.

items.title: Writes the headline too
items.body: A title on every post, written to each platform's own character limit — and never missing on Reddit, YouTube or Pinterest, where nothing publishes without one.

items.title: Schedules everywhere
items.body: One grid for all ten platforms. Queue a week, move a post to a better slot, and Linka publishes it through the official API.

items.title: Trends, before they peak
items.body: Fresh topics in your niche, scored and dated, each one with hook angles you can send straight to the writer.

items.title: Replies drafted for you

items.title: Insights that act

items.q: Will it actually sound like me?
items.a: That's what Voice Lab is for. Paste old posts, upload a file or import your LinkedIn export, and Linka pulls your hooks, rhythm and sign-offs from real samples. Most users edit fewer than 3 words per draft.
Ten: LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Bluesky and Reddit — all through official APIs.

items.q: Does it post the same text everywhere?
items.a: No. Every platform gets its own draft: a 120–220 word LinkedIn post, under 280 characters on X, a Reddit post with the marketing voice stripped out. You set the goal, tone and post types per platform once, and Linka writes to them.

Hashtags are chosen after the post is finished, capped per platform — 3 on LinkedIn, 5 on Instagram, none on Reddit or Facebook — and invented tags are rejected. Titles are written to each platform's own limit, including the ones that won't publish without one.

items.q: Can it write in my language?
items.a: Yes — 23 languages, written natively rather than translated from English. Set your default once in settings and override it per post when you need to.
Linka writes a script from the finished post, then renders your avatar speaking it — vertical or landscape, 30 or 60 seconds, in the post's language. Renders are capped per day to keep costs sane.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No. Connect once via OAuth and posts publish through official APIs — no browser extension, no copy-paste, no manual steps.

items.q: Which DMs and comments can it reply to?
items.a: DMs on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, Bluesky and Reddit, plus comments on Threads and YouTube. TikTok and Pinterest are publish-only for now. The inbox is on the Business plan.

items.q: What if I don't like a draft?
items.a: Regenerate it, edit it inline, or skip it. Nothing publishes until you approve it.
There's a free plan instead — 5 AI posts a month, no card, no time limit. Upgrade when you need more volume.
Yes — one click from billing opens the Stripe portal. You keep access until the end of the period you've paid for.
